message.content: During their meeting at "Central Perk," Li Hua suggested several design elements for Yuriko's studio homepage. Specifically, Li Hua proposed the inclusion of a user feedback section with a simple form for users to leave comments or suggestions, as well as a star rating system to evaluate the quality of service. Additionally, Li Hua suggested adding space for testimonials, which would help build trust with potential clients. To match the overall aesthetic of the studio, Li Hua recommended using soft and calming pastel colors for the feedback section. These design suggestions were aimed at enhancing the functionality and user experience of the studio's website, thereby improving its appeal and effectiveness in reaching out to potential clients.
